narrative.overview:
A 16th Street dining-room journal. Cream paper and a large serif headline introduce the full-width communal-table photograph. The desktop portrait arch is gone: this homepage uses a square, 630px-high wide image. Mobile stacks the copy and actions, uses a 430px photograph and crops to 64% 50%.

The new homepage is cream with olive ink and napkin-pink actions. Existing inner pages retain their green canvas, cream type and marigold actions. The homepage has no arched hero image; retain square frames for its current wide photographic treatment.
keyCharacteristics: Eight complete homepage content sections grounded in real menu and venue evidence.
Text-only actions, real photographs and restrained motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Route Scope Rule
rules.body: Homepage tokens apply only with the pitch-home body class. Preserve the existing inner-page tokens for routes that do not load pitch.css.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces, rules and real photography for depth. Do not add box shadows.

dos: Do keep the homepage and inner-page palettes scoped to their own routes.
Do preserve the eight-section homepage sequence and all six real menu selections.
Do keep location, photo, programming and service-link claims tied to data/revision-facts.json.
Do retain visible focus, text-only 2px controls, keyboard gallery behavior and click-to-load maps.
donts: Don't reuse another venue's opening, typography treatment or signature composition.
Don't restore the removed hero overlines or repeated section-rise entrances.
Don't invent reviews, awards, quotes, founder details, menu items or parking guarantees.
Don't use generic hospitality slogans, decorative arrows, highlighted words, tilted labels, theme switches or em dashes in homepage copy.
